description: Activates representative Staff abilities through the real activation pipeline and records the outcome of each.
inputs: Each ability is used by a fresh nw_bandit001 (2000 HP, 9999 FP and stamina, no regeneration) on the target its behavior case names: itself, a hostile training dummy or a friendly creature one and a half metres away. The clock is frozen at 2026-01-15 12:00:00 UTC, so effect durations are the full applied durations. Random is seeded with 20261031 plus the ability's position immediately before the activation. HP columns are the change from before the activation; effects are written 'name:remainingSeconds'.
rows: targets 1, critical hits 0, damage 11, skill Staff
